notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding one mana of any color.
Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
